flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: --custom-query
flags.description: Perform a custom query. Supports username, password, ip, hash, domain. Performs an implicit "loose" search when searching locally

flags.name: --loose
flags.description: Allow loose search by disabling email pattern recognition. Use spaces as pattern seperators

flags.name: --breachcomp
flags.description: Path to the breachcompilation torrent folder. Uses the query.sh script included in the torrent

flags.name: --skip-defaults
flags.description: Skips Scylla and HunterIO check. Ideal for local scans

flags.name: --single-file
flags.description: If breach contains big cleartext or tar.gz files, set this flag to view the progress bar. Disables concurrent file searching for stability

flags.name: --chase
flags.description: Add related emails from hunter.io to ongoing target list. Define number of emails per target to chase. Requires hunter.io private API key if used without power-chase

flags.name: --power-chase
flags.description: Add related emails from ALL API services to ongoing target list. Use with --chase

flags.name: --hide
flags.description: Only shows the first 4 characters of found passwords to output. Ideal for demonstrations

flags.name: --gen-config
flags.description: Generates a configuration file template in the current working directory & exits. Will overwrite existing h8mail_config.ini file
